settings.Name: Halcyon
settings.Description:
A golden-hour Mediterranean archipelago. Every player wakes on an island of their own, and nothing reaches you that did not sail. A ring of contested islets in the middle sea carries the stone and metal nobody has at home — easy to take, hard to keep. The shoals are thick with fish, so a fleet can feed itself.

[color="red"]IMPORTANT: This map requires the Halcyon mod.[/color]
